MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT — Version B
Effective date: 1 January 2025. Acme Private Limited (Customer) and Beta Solutions (Supplier).
1. Payment. Customer shall pay invoices within 45 days of receipt.
2. Services. Supplier must deliver the services and monthly reports by the fifth day of each month.
3. Termination. Either party may terminate for convenience with 90 days' written notice.
4. Renewal. This agreement renews for one year only by written agreement of both parties.
5. Indemnification. Supplier shall indemnify Customer for third-party claims arising from Supplier's breach.
6. Liability. Liability is capped at INR 25,00,000, except for fraud and confidentiality breaches.
7. Confidentiality. Confidentiality obligations survive termination for 5 years.
8. Intellectual Property. Customer owns all work product and Supplier assigns rights to Customer.
9. Governing Law and Jurisdiction. The laws of India apply and courts in Mumbai have jurisdiction.
11. Audit. Customer may audit Supplier's compliance records on reasonable notice.
